items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: a friend of mine named Steele...

ctx.x: After I left Kirby, I was home, and let me see... I wasn't home all the time. Yeah, I was home this time, too. That when Steele came by the house. Yeah, that's right. I had finished with Kirby's band, and a friend of mine named Steele...
